note: The v2 happy path for a Process Revision: a rule that no longer fits, a proposed change, and the cost of keeping it. If this drifts to Continuous Improvement the type descriptions are not carrying enough signal, as in approval-threshold.
turns: Every outbound shipment needs a manager signature before it leaves the dock, even repeat customers under $500. That rule was written when we had two clients and it adds an hour of waiting most afternoons. We should drop the signature for repeat customers under $500.
